title: Apprenda  - Java Support and JP Morgan Chase

asr.full_text: The Apprenda platform now has best-in-class support for Java. The same functionality that you've grown to love on the .NET side has been brought over. To the rest of the app portfolio in the enterprise. Coming to market with production customers like JPMorgan Chase is simply amazing. With over 2,000 applications across 500 development teams and in use by every line of business,. JPMorgan's use of Apprenda epitomizes what at-scale enterprise IT private pass looks. Like. This is what Apprenda was built to do, fuel the next generation of enterprise IT by establishing. The standard and enterprise-grade private pass.
